% table-merged — a ruled table with a cell spanning two columns and one spanning two rows.
%
% GFM has no spans, so the gold file states the rule this project follows: a merged
% cell's text goes in the first cell it covers, and the cells it also covers are
% empty. The spanning header is above two columns, and the spanning row label is
% beside two rows, so both directions of merging are covered.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{multirow}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\begin{tabular}{|l|r|r|}
\hline
 & \multicolumn{2}{c|}{Sales} \\
\cline{2-3}
Product & 2024 & 2025 \\
\hline
\multirow{2}{*}{Kettles} & 120 & 135 \\
\cline{2-3}
 & 80 & 95 \\
\hline
Toasters & 60 & 72 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{document}
